archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Admin) mixed with Clean Organic (Storefront)

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings above 24px.

body.usage: Clean, legible reading for storefront and dense data in admin.

code_or_mono.usage: Order IDs, SKUs, and numerical data.

admin_dashboard.grid: Control Room Grid (gap-4 or gap-6). Dense layout to maximize data visibility.
admin_dashboard.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px border (#E5E7EB), minimal to no shadow (shadow-sm at most). Use rounded-lg.
admin_dashboard.padding: Internal card padding: p-6. Tab content wrapper: py-6.

ecommerce_storefront.grid: Bento Grid (gap-8) for marketing sections. Generous breathing room.

header_responsive_fix.issue: Buttons on header going left on tablet/smaller.
header_responsive_fix.solution: Use CSS Grid or Flexbox with strict justify properties. Example: `<header className="flex items-center justify-between w-full p-4">`. Left section (Nav/Hamburger) `flex-1`, Center (Logo) `flex-none`, Right (Actions/Cart) `flex-1 justify-end`. Ensure mobile menu wraps correctly using `hidden md:flex` and a hamburger icon `flex md:hidden`.

checkout_flow.layout: One-page split layout. Left: Form steps (Shipping, Payment). Right: Order summary with a light gray (#F9FAFB) background. Mobile: Summary becomes a collapsible accordion at the top.
checkout_flow.navigation: Hide main site navigation and footer during checkout to prevent cart abandonment. Only show logo (linked to home) and a back link.
checkout_flow.forms: Use Shadcn UI Input, Select. Maximize width. Explicit error states in red text below inputs.

admin_tables.style: MedusaJS style: 1px border, white background. Table headers should be uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs, text-gray-500. Table rows have border-b. Hover state on rows: bg-gray-50.

admin_tabs.style: Underline tabs for secondary navigation. text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700. Active state: text-primary border-b-2 border-primary.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons translate-y-[1px] or darken slightly. Table rows highlight bg-gray-50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Outfit font for storefront headings and Admin Dashboard primary titles. Use Inter for body text and data.
Fix the header layout in responsive view by strictly using flex-1 for left/right sections and center-aligning the logo, or explicitly using justify-between for the mobile wrapper.
Refactor Admin Dashboard completely to match MedusaJS style: Flat white cards, light gray backgrounds (bg-gray-50), subtle borders (border-gray-200), and dense tabular data.
Simplify Checkout to a one-page setup with no distractions. Mute the header. Form on the left, gray Order Summary on the right.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button', data-testid='admin-settings-tab').
Preserve the Razorpay mock implementation but refine the UI of the selection process.
Ensure the Google Sign in logic is completely removed as requested.
